method: Greedy one-to-one matching between Frank regions and Koharu text or onomatopoeia regions. A pair matches when either box center falls inside the other box. Every unmatched crop was then reviewed visually.
frank_only_false_or_irrelevant: manga__adult6_original F1: Latin hotel sign outside Japanese translation scope
koharu_only_false_duplicate_or_interface: manga__adult2 K17 and K18: duplicate punctuation instances
manga__adult4 K17 and K18: page number fragments
manga__adult6_original K11 and K12: page number fragments
manga__shounen11 K23, K24, and K26: duplicate parts of one large SFX
manga__shounen7 K22 and K24: page numbers
manga__shounen9 K12 and K17: duplicate SFX instances
manga__tiny K19, K20, and K22: page number or divider fragments
notes: The review measures useful region coverage and disagreement quality. It is not a conventional independently drawn box or polygon ground-truth set.
Koharu separates text, SFX, balloons, and panels. Frank combines several region meanings, so direct class-name precision and recall would be misleading.
Most genuine Koharu-only regions are stylized SFX that Frank does not return.
The F and K indices refer to the generated disagreement review sheets, not stable model instance identifiers.
